e.title: Medical Insurance Fraud Detection（天池医保欺诈）
e.summary: 2017 天池医保欺诈检测比赛 top-16/1300 方案（33★）：600 万条医保结算数据的基金欺诈挖掘
e.body: Medical-Insurance-Fraud-Detection（YoungGod，33★）是 2017 天池大赛『医保欺诈检测』（中国社会保险学会+阿里主办，600 万+条医保结算与费用明细数据）的 top-16 方案（两轮 15/16 名，1300+ 队伍）。对 RIAA：中文健康险/医保基金欺诈检测的经典比赛方案——特征工程与模型方法（与英文系 [[claims-fraud-guardian]]、[[networkfraud]] 的学术方法互补）；中国医保数据语境与 [[insurance-ner-nre]]（中文保险文本）、[[hcc-python]]（美国风险调整）对照理解中美健康险数据差异。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：天池医保欺诈比赛 top-16/1300 方案（33★，2017）
e.title_hk: Medical Insurance Fraud Detection（天池醫保欺詐）
e.summary_en: Top-16/1300 solution of the 2017 Tianchi medical-insurance fraud contest (33★): mining fund fraud from 6M+ medical insurance settlement records
e.summary_hk: 2017 天池醫保欺詐檢測比賽 top-16/1300 方案（33★）：600 萬條醫保結算數據的基金欺詐挖掘
e.body_en: Medical-Insurance-Fraud-Detection (YoungGod, 33★) is a top-16 solution (rank 15/16 in the two rounds among 1300+ teams) of the 2017 Tianchi 'medical insurance fraud detection' contest (hosted by the Chinese Society of Social Insurance and Alibaba, with 6M+ individual medical insurance settlement records and detailed expense data). For RIAA: a classic contest solution for Chinese health-insurance/medical-fund fraud detection — feature engineering and modelling contrasted with the academic methods of [[claims-fraud-guardian]] and [[networkfraud]]; the Chinese medical-data context pairs with [[insurance-ner-nre]] (Chinese insurance text) and contrasts with [[hcc-python]] (US risk adjustment) to understand China-vs-US health data differences.
e.body_hk: Medical-Insurance-Fraud-Detection（YoungGod，33★）是 2017 天池大賽『醫保欺詐檢測』（中國社會保險學會+阿里主辦，600 萬+條醫保結算與費用明細數據）的 top-16 方案（兩輪 15/16 名，1300+ 隊伍）。對 RIAA：中文健康險/醫保基金欺詐檢測的經典比賽方案——特徵工程與模型方法（與英文系 [[claims-fraud-guardian]]、[[networkfraud]] 的學術方法互補）；中國醫保數據語境與 [[insurance-ner-nre]]（中文保險文本）、[[hcc-python]]（美國風險調整）對照理解中美健康險數據差異。
